title: Kissed British Rice Mousse
description: A citrusy, molten rice mousse that is kid-friendly and diabetic-friendly, featuring jasmine rice and kombu cold extract.

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: optional, use sugar-free syrup if preferred

instructions: Rinse the jasmine rice until the water runs clear.
Place the rice, kombu sheet, and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and the kombu is soft.
Remove the kombu sheet and let the rice cool slightly before blending.
Blend the cooked rice, almond milk, coconut milk, lemon zest, lemon juice, sea salt, and honey until smooth.
Heat the blended mixture over low heat, stirring until warm, then whisk in the dissolved agar-agar powder until fully dissolved.
Pour the mixture into individual ramekins and refrigerate for at least 120 minutes until set.
Serve chilled, optionally topping with a drizzle of extra coconut milk or a sprinkle of lemon zest.
